'''Oscar P. Bruno''' is Professor of Applied & Computational Mathematics in the Computing and Mathematical Sciences Department at the [[California Institute of Technology]]. He is known for research on [[numerical analysis]].

==Academic biography==
Bruno received the Licenciado degree from the [[University of Buenos Aires]] in 1982, and he completed the PhD in mathematics at [[New York University]] in 1989.<ref name="cv">[http://www.its.caltech.edu/~obruno/biography.htm Oscar P. Bruno ''curriculum vitae''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180817015409/http://www.its.caltech.edu/~obruno/biography.htm |date=2018-08-17 }} Retrieved August 11, 2014</ref>
His adviser was [[Robert V. Kohn]], and his dissertation was titled ''The Effective Conductivity of an Infinitely Interchangeable Mixture''.<ref>[http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=33750 Oscar P. Bruno] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180809040029/https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=33750 |date=2018-08-09 }} at the [[Mathematics Genealogy Project]]</ref>
He taught at the [[University of Minnesota]] from 1989 to 1991, and he was at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] from 1991 to 1995.<ref name="cv"/>
He has been on the faculty of the [[California Institute of Technology]] since 1995.<ref>[http://directory.caltech.edu/personnel/obruno Oscar P. Bruno] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160307080125/https://directory.caltech.edu/personnel/obruno |date=2016-03-07 }} at the [http://directory.caltech.edu Caltech Directory] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180212023955/https://directory.caltech.edu/ |date=2018-02-12 }}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
In 1994, Bruno was awarded an [[Sloan Fellowship|Alfred P. Sloan Research Fellowship]].<ref>[http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/ Sloan Foundation, Past Fellows] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161106043224/http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/ |date=2016-11-06 }}</ref>
He was inducted as a Fellow of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM) in 2013.<ref>[http://fellows.siam.org/index.php?sort=year&value=2013 SIAM Fellows: Class of 2013] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180811024009/http://fellows.siam.org/index.php?sort=year&value=2013 |date=2018-08-11 }}</ref>
